Wayne Heim's fine art transportation photography explores machines as witnesses to human ambition, where steel, steam, and distance carried consequence as much as cargo. Light and structure shape a narrative rooted in transition, industry, and memory. Part of Wayne Heim's fine art transportation photography collection. © Wayne Heim
